title: Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 (Act 15 of 2017), Acts Supplement No. 17 of 2017; section 53(6) amends the Telecommunications Act
kind: the text of the Act or notification, from the e-Gazette copy
header_as_printed: Companies (Amendment) Bill / Bill No. 13/2017. / Read the first time on 28 February 2017. / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / GOVERNMENT GAZETTE / ACTS SUPPLEMENT / Published by Authority / NO. 17] FRIDAY, MARCH 31 [2017 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 30 March 2017 at 5 pm. / The following Act was passed by Parliament on 10 March 2017 and assented / to by the President on 29 March 2017:— / REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / No. 15 of 2017. / I assent.
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 30 March 2017 at 5 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch4.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
